description: Department of  Fiscal Policy - Order made to declare that the Excise Duty on lotteries shall be payable w.e.f. 01.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette content contains an order issued under the Excise (Special Provisions) Act, No. 13 of 1989, which modifies excise duty rates on specific articles (lottery tickets). This constitutes a regulatory change and falls under legal/regulatory matters, specifically the creation or modification of regulations under existing legislation. While it names the Minister of Finance, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (it only states his title as part of the authorization), so it does not qualify as a Hybrid (Type 3) gazette. The primary content is regulatory in nature.
